traducciones.1. Abre esperianarchive.com en tu navega:

traducciones.1. Inicia sesión en esperianarchive.com:

4. Come back here and press «Choose file and import…»: the inventory first, then the runs.

traducciones.1. afk-inventory.json (primero): la capt:
1. afk-inventory.json (first): a snapshot of one character (resources, heroes, collections, gear, pets). It includes the character's UID and server: if it's new, the app registers it and asks for its name. It replaces that character's 'My account' (the previous one is kept as cuenta_actual.anterior.json).
2. afk-runs.json: NC runs. It doesn't say which character played them: you pick one of yours or a friend. Missing runs are added; runs you already had get their statistics added (damage, healing, energy…). Runs from other modes (CR) are skipped.
• Shared runs (.json from this app): runs with the hero that used the SP in each round, plus statistics.
• .zip: a backup exported from this app.
Several characters? Import each one's afk-inventory.json (on the site, Fetch that character and download it again).

traducciones.• Copia .zip: todo lo de un servidor o d:
• .zip backup: everything from a server or a friend (runs, details, My account, Rift, blocks) to move it to another PC or keep a backup.
• Runs to share (.json): only the NC runs, with the hero that used the SP in each round and the statistics. It's what you should send a friend: afk-runs.json doesn't keep the SP.
traducciones.• Elige una sección a la izquierda.\n• L:
• Choose a section on the left.
• Heroes with a green ✓ are yours; the gray dot means you don't have them.
• Hover over an image to see what it is.
• Click a hero to see your build, whether its collection meets the guide and how you did with it in NC.
• 'Translate terms' changes frequent Russian words to Spanish.
• Use the zoom and the mouse wheel (Shift + wheel = horizontal).
traducciones.• afk-runs.json: runs de NC. Al importar:
• afk-runs.json: NC runs. When importing it asks whose they are: yours (account and server) or a friend's. The missing ones are added; the ones you already downloaded from the site get the statistics added (damage, healing, energy…). Runs from other modes (CR) are skipped.
• shared runs (.json from this app): runs with the SP hero of each round and their statistics.
• afk-inventory.json: your account capture (resources, heroes, collections, gear, pets). It replaces 'My account' (the previous one is kept as cuenta_actual.anterior.json).
• .zip: a backup exported from this app.
